title: 5D entry
description: A span-grounded unit (spec/SPEC.md §4): source_urn, start, end, and the exact text slice over cleaned text, plus an optional implementation-assigned id and an optional dominant dimension (schema: position.schema.json describes the full fingerprint, computed separately). 5D is neutral on is/ought (§7, N1): this schema carries no is/ought enforcement at all — whether an entry's content is normative is nD-grammar knowledge (a co-dimension on that grammar's own NDSystem, §9), never something this schema inspects. This $id resolves once the repository is published; until then, resolve schema $refs from a local copy (see tests/test_conformance.py).

id.description: Optional implementation-assigned entry id (e.g. versum's content-addressed entry_id).

dimension.description: Optional dominant dimension of this entry's fingerprint (§5).
